annotations.title: Summarize URL or text to JSON brief

description: [PAID $0.02 USDC per call via x402 on Base; errors are free] Fetch a public web page (or take raw text) and return a structured JSON brief made by Llama 3.3 70B: title, language, contentType, summary, keyPoints, named entities with types, topic tags, concrete facts (prices, dates, versions, limits) as label/value pairs, sentiment and audience. Grounded in the page only, no invented facts. Reads up to 24,000 chars of main content (2 MB HTML, 10 s fetch timeout). All params optional: with none it summarizes https://example.com. GET with query params, or POST a JSON body for long text (up to 200,000 chars accepted, first 24,000 analyzed).

focus.description: Optional aspect to emphasize, e.g. "pricing", "API limits", "risks" (max 200 chars).

lang.description: Optional output language for summary/keyPoints (ISO 639-1, e.g. "en"). Default: same as the content.

length.description: Summary length: short = 1-2 sentences, medium = 3-4 (default), long = 5-8.

text.description: Raw text or Markdown to summarize instead of a URL (optional, max 200000 chars, first 24000 analyzed). Prefer POST for long text.

url.description: Public http(s) URL to read (hostname, not IP; private addresses refused). Optional: defaults to https://example.com. Ignored when `text` is given.

name: summarize
title: Summarize URL or text to JSON brief
